decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority (before the building(s) is/are occupied/used).

Condition : 3 - It is considered the this application for the sub-division of the existing unit, would not be detrimental to the apperance of the original unit, the character of the street scene or to the amenities of the area. On balance the develompent is considered to comply with policies ENV-B.1.1(New Development) of the London Borough of Hounslow UDP, Adopted December 2003. It is considered that where the development is not compliant there are no undue adverse effects resulting from this.
description: Permanent diverting existing services on the bridge to new pipe bridges erected adjacent to the brick arch bridge. Replacing concrete slab under carriageway with new reinforced concrete slab. Repointing of all brickwork joints. Restoring the parapet walls and the iron straps on copings.
